n_problem1.text: You think faster than you type.

n_problem2.text: So you try dictation. And it writes down exactly what you said. <break time="0.3s" /> Every um. <break time="0.2s" /> Every false start. <break time="0.2s" /> Every wait, no.

n_problem3.text: And you spend longer fixing the prompt than it took to say it.

n_intro.text: Meet parley. Push to talk for Claude Code, with speech by Gradium.

n_how.text: Hold a key. <break time="0.25s" /> Talk. <break time="0.25s" /> Let go.

d_before.text: Um, so, can you, uh <break time="0.4s" /> add rate limiting to the, the login endpoint? Like, five requests a minute. <break time="0.3s" /> Wait, no, actually, make that ten. <break time="0.3s" /> And, uh, put it in the auth file.

n_gets.text: That's what you said. Here's what Claude gets.

d_after.text: Can you add rate limiting to the login endpoint? Like ten requests a minute, and put it in auth dot ts.

n_compare.text: The fillers are gone. Your correction is applied. And the file is found by name.

f_commands.text: Say stop, undo that, clear the chat, or compact, and parley presses the keys for you.

f_lang.text: Speak French, German, Spanish or Portuguese. Claude still gets English.

d_french.text: Euh, est-ce que tu peux ajouter des tests pour la page de connexion ? Surtout les cas d'erreur.

f_answer.text: Ask for the answer out loud, and Claude's reply is read back to you.

c_answer.text: Done. Login is limited to ten requests a minute, and the new test passes.

f_ask.text: When Claude asks you something, parley chimes and opens the mic. You just answer.

d_reply.text: Yes, add the test. And, uh, tell me out loud when it's done.

f_learn.text: Fix a misheard word once, and parley remembers it.

f_history.text: And nothing is lost. Every turn is kept, so you can always see what it heard.

n_outro.text: parley. Just talk to Claude Code.
